conclusion.reason: Client semantics documented: final panel attributes and skill list are server-provided (HeroAttrInfo.modules[].subModules[].attrs/skills); the client never applies hero_rank.attribute or hero_rank.skill from tables. Product decision 2026-08-07: hero_rank is unimplemented dead config in the current client (no UI/protocol/system-open/guide wiring; every HeroRank-named client artifact actually refers to talent_rank). Cultivation state and values are therefore not affected by hero_rank, and the optimizer does not specify it. The adjacent-rank capture contract is archived as evidence of the superseded closure path and is no longer required.
